I am 58 years old and I never went to school; I learned farming from my father and by watching my neighbors. This rice plot is only 0.25 hectares but it is my own land, so I will put cow manure on it and about a quarter of a bag of urea that I bought from the cooperative—last year my cousin used urea on his rice and the heads were full. I will use my own saved seed, I will not buy chemicals, and I do not irrigate because the rain and the swamp give water. My wife and children will do all the work—planting, weeding, harvesting—about 45 days altogether, and I have no money to hire workers.
